title: Writing Game Stories That Survive Player Choice
authorship: New independent narrated observations; preserve all twelve original scenes and explanation voice.

scenes.title: 질문한 뒤 다시 말을 걸어 본다
lines: We first ask about a rule we do not know. When we speak again, the guard continues the conversation instead of repeating the first explanation.
Compare the first greeting with the response after the explanation. What was said matters more than the number of visits.

scenes.title: 회수 대신 동료를 다시 부르면
lines: This time we call the companion back instead of recovering the seal. The companion still owns it, but the option to show it returns when they are present.
Compare the replies while the companion is absent and after they return. Ownership and current access require separate checks.

scenes.title: 세 번째 선택의 흔적도 확인한다
lines: Let us try the third option. After we make the animal move aside, the guard mentions that action instead of saying we fed it.
The same character changes one sentence when the earlier action changes. A shared destination does not have to erase the choice.

scenes.title: 끝낸 사건을 다시 요구하지 않는다
lines: After handing over the seal, we talk to the guard again. The reply now invites us inside instead of demanding the same object.
We also check whether the conversation remembers a completed event. Asking again just because the object left our hands would undo the story progress.
